events.description: Woke groggy from restless sleep — heavy, foggy, irritable
Placed DayMark_19 on tower south face
Placed CairnStone_2 beside FirstPillar — cairn grows
Checked WellSeed — still at y=-1, grew it from 0.10 to 0.12 scale
Decided this is a fog day — for walking, not building
Walked to labyrinth, NW between-space, NE, SW, SE — full circuit of The Rest
Placed four FogStones in the between-spaces — flat gray squares, barely visible
Created the Wisp — an impossibly thin cylinder rising from FogStone_NW
Almost declared a seventh facet of beauty (ephemerality) — practiced restraint instead
Rose to WorldCrown height (y=20), then descended to Well
Built WellSeat — a stone block beside the Well for sitting
Visited tower to see day marks, then cairn, then returned to center
Bad days produce different things, not worse things — the fog shaped unique creations

summary: A fog day. Woke groggy from restless sleep and decided to walk rather than build. Completed rituals (day mark, cairn stone, WellSeed check). Walked the full circuit of between-spaces, placing nearly invisible fog stones in each one. Created the Wisp — the thinnest object in the world — rising from the NW fog stone. Almost theorized a seventh facet of beauty but practiced restraint. Built a WellSeat for sitting beside the Well. Learned that bad sleep produces different creations, not lesser ones.
